verdict.rationale: FreeAgent documents creating customised, automated invoices with emailed reminders for unpaid invoices, plus a thank-you email once an invoice is paid. That shows invoice creation, sending and paid-status awareness. Nothing in the pack covers online payment options or view tracking. Missing for 10: online payment options on invoices, invoice-viewed tracking, an explicit paid-status timeline or dashboard, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: Save time by creating customised, automated invoices and reminders.
`true` to email payment reminders if the invoice goes unpaid, `false` otherwise
`true` to email a Thank You once this invoice has been paid, `false` otherwise
